in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Adolfo could be derived from the Hebrew words 'adol' meaning noble and 'olf' meaning wolf. Together, the name would mean 'Noble wolf'.

in_greek.name: Ἀδολφός
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Adolfo could be derived from the Greek word 'Adonis' meaning man or lord, with the suffix '-phos' meaning 'man of'. Together, the name would mean 'Man of Adonis'.

in_latin.name: Adolphus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Adolfo could be derived from the Latin words 'ad' meaning noble and 'lupus' meaning wolf. Together, the name would mean 'Noble wolf'.
